Validate unequal-replication random-intercept inference

simulate_unequal_random_intercept_validation.Rd

Compares the Phase 11 distance engine with an independent scalar cluster-centroid Freedman–Lane implementation under a null and location alternative. Cluster sizes are 2, 3, and 5, with both treatments represented within every size stratum.

Usage

simulate_unequal_random_intercept_validation(
  simulations = 500L,
  permutations = 99L,
  effect = 1,
  cluster_sd = 1,
  residual_sd = 1,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = 20260719L,
  keep_results = FALSE
)

Arguments

simulations

Number of simulations per scenario.

permutations

Monte Carlo permutations per fit.

effect

Cluster-level treatment shift in the power scenario.

cluster_sd, residual_sd

Generating standard deviations.

alpha

Rejection threshold.

seed

Reproducibility seed.

keep_results

Retain iteration-level results.

Value

A Phase 11 validation report.
